description: Elsevier's elsarticle in its two-column 5p format. Its preamble, as elsarticle-preprint's (batch 1, round 2): \title takes a paragraph (elsarticle.cls l.123-125 with \long; General's title ends its \parbox with \par), and where a way loads titlesec \paragraph gets elsarticle's own run-in format, since elsarticle defines it through \secdef (l.1069-1076) and titlesec gives such a command no format ('No format for this command').
